title: Witherhoard Catalyst Guide
summary: How to get and complete the Witherhoard Catalyst (The Bank Job).
content:
Acquisition: Pick up 'The Bank Job' quest from Banshee-44 at the Tower after obtaining Witherhoard.

Quest Steps:
1. 50 Vault Keys: Defeat combatants with Kinetic or Special Grenade Launchers.
2. 300 Filthy Lucre: Earned by completing Vanguard Ops, Crucible matches, or Gambit matches (boosted by Season Pass boosters if active).
3. 200 Grenade Launcher Multikills: Anywhere in PVE.
4. 100 Grenade Launcher Guardian Kills: In Crucible, Momentum Control or Iron Banner with Wave Frame GLs (like Forbearance) or Heavy GLs.

Catalyst Completion: Defeat 400 combatants with Witherhoard. (Tip: Farm at Shuro Chi checkpoint in Last Wish or Grasp of Avarice opening loot cave).

Catalyst Perk: 'Silent Alarm' — Increases Handling to 100 and adds Auto-Loading Holster. Essential for PVE DPS rotations (fire shot, swap to heavy/fusion, auto-reloads in pocket).

title: Gjallarhorn Catalyst Guide
summary: How to get and complete the Gjallarhorn Catalyst in Grasp of Avarice.
content:
Acquisition: Found inside the Grasp of Avarice dungeon on Cosmodrome. You must defeat Reaver Vandals holding burden engrams and open three hidden Golden Chests:
- Chest 1: Right after the opening loot cave, defeat Vandal across the chasm, deposit burden in chest.
- Chest 2: In the flooded ventilation section after the barrel trap.
- Chest 3: Shield encounter island puzzle before the final boss.

Catalyst Completion: Defeat 400 combatants with Gjallarhorn. (Easy with Shuro Chi or Altars of Sorrow).

Catalyst Perk: 'More Roses, More Thorns' — Increases magazine size to 2 rockets! Precision hits or final blows spawn faster, more damaging Wolfpack rounds. Makes Gjallarhorn a top-tier fireteam support weapon for rocket DPS strategies.

title: Outbreak Perfected Catalyst Guide
summary: Zero Hour exotic mission catalyst details and nanite upgrade.
content:
Acquisition: Complete the 'Zero Hour' exotic mission. The catalyst can be earned through the Legend difficulty completion or associated puzzle vault switches.

Catalyst Completion: Defeat 500 combatants with Outbreak Perfected and land rapid precision hits.

Catalyst Perk: Nanites deal increased damage. Enemies eliminated with nanites attached spawn additional SIVA nanites. Turns Outbreak into one of the highest sustained primary ammo DPS weapons in the game, especially when stacked across a 6-player raid fireteam.

title: Sunshot Catalyst Guide
summary: Sun Blast catalyst stats and rapid completion strategy.
content:
Acquisition: Random drop from playlist activities (Vanguard Strikes, Nightfalls, Crucible, Gambit).

Catalyst Completion:
- 500 combatant kills with Sunshot
- 1,000 Sun Blast explosion kills
Tip: Best farmed in the 'In the Deep' Shadowkeep campaign mission thrall hallway, Shuro Chi, or Breakneck mission checkpoint.

Catalyst Perk: Grants +30 Range and +20 Stability. In Season of the Wish/The Final Shape with Solar 3.0 and artifact mods, Sunshot is the premier add-clear Hand Cannon that easily triggers ignitions and scorch stacks.

title: Trinity Ghoul Catalyst Guide
summary: Transforms Trinity Ghoul into an unstoppable chain-lightning clearing machine.
content:
Acquisition: Random drop upon completing any core playlist activity (Strikes, Crucible, Gambit).

Catalyst Completion: Defeat 400 combatants with Trinity Ghoul.

Catalyst Perk: 'Forked Lightning' — Lightning Rod perk now activates on ANY Arc final blow (including melee, grenades, or the chain lightning itself!), not just precision bow kills. You can shoot at the floor and wipe entire waves of enemies.

title: Solar Warlock - Infinite Sunbracers Grenade Spam
summary: Endless Solar Grenades, Restoration x2, and massive room-clearing DPS.
content:
Subclass: Solar 3.0 Warlock
Super: Well of Radiance or Song of Flame
Aspects: Touch of Flame (enhanced Solar grenades with magma blobs) + Icarus Dash or Heat Rises
Fragments: Ember of Empyrean (extends restoration/radiant on solar kills), Ember of Torches (powered melee grants Radiant), Ember of Ashes (more scorch), Ember of Searing (firesprites on scorched kills).
Exotic Armor: Sunbracers (Exotic Gauntlets)
Key Loop: Snap fingers with Incinerator Snap to kill red-bar enemy -> Activates Sunbracers Ready -> Throw up to 5 Solar Grenades within 4 seconds -> Phoenix Dive grants Restoration x2 -> Every solar kill resets timer to 12s.
Weapons: Sunshot / Calus Mini-Tool (Incandescent) + Apex Predator / Edge Transit.

title: Prismatic Titan - Triple Consecration Ignitions
summary: Triple Frenzied Blade charges fueling massive Solar Consecration wave slams.
content:
Subclass: Prismatic Titan
Super: Twilight Arsenal (Void) or Hammer of Sol
Aspects: Consecration (slide melee sends solar wave then slam ignition) + Knockout (melee kills start health regen & boost melee range/damage)
Melee: Frenzied Blade (Grants 3 melee charges on Prismatic!)
Fragments: Facet of Courage (light abilities do more damage to darkness-debuffed targets), Facet of Blessing (melee final blows start health regen), Facet of Dawn (powered melee makes radiant), Facet of Ruin (increases ignition & shatter radius).
Exotic Armor: Synthoceps (huge melee & super damage when surrounded) or Exotic Class Item (Spirit of Synthoceps + Spirit of Inmost Light).
Loop: Slide -> Tap Melee -> Tap Melee again -> Massive fiery slam deletes entire packs and Champions in Grandmasters.

title: Void Hunter - Gyrfalcon's Infinite Invisibility & Volatile
summary: Non-stop invisibility loops with volatile rounds and overshields.
content:
Subclass: Void 3.0 Hunter (Nightstalker)
Super: Shadowshot: Deadfall (for 30% team debuff) or Moebius Quiver
Aspects: Stylish Executioner (defeating void-debuffed target grants invisibility and Truesight) + Vanishing Step (dodge to go invisible)
Fragments: Echo of Starvation (picking up orb of power or void breach grants Devour), Echo of Persistence (invis and devour last longer), Echo of Cessation (finisher creates volatile blast).
Exotic Armor: Gyrfalcon's Hauberk
Weapons: Graviton Lance / Funnelweb / Buried Bloodline / The Title
Loop: Dodge or get invisible -> Come out firing Void weapon -> All rounds are Volatile -> Volatile target dies -> Stylish Executioner triggers -> Go invisible again! Devour keeps health full permanently.

title: Champion Counters & Stun Mechanics
summary: Comprehensive guide to stunning Barrier, Overload, and Unstoppable champions via subclass verbs and weapons.
content:
Barrier Champions:
- Subclass Verbs: Radiant (Solar), Volatile Rounds (Void), Unraveling Rounds (Strand).
- Weapons: Match current seasonal artifact or intrinsic exotics (Wish-Ender, Arbalest, Revision Zero, Eriana's Vow).
- Tactic: Wait for shield to activate, fire anti-barrier weapon until shield shatters to interrupt health regeneration.

Overload Champions:
- Subclass Verbs: Jolt (Arc), Slow & Freeze (Stasis), Suppression (Void).
- Weapons: Intrinsic exotics (Divinity, Le Monarque, Thunderlord).
- Tactic: Constant fire prevents health regeneration. Re-stun immediately after stun cooldown glow fades.

Unstoppable Champions:
- Subclass Verbs: Ignition (Solar), Suspend (Strand), Shatter (Stasis), Blind (Arc).
- Weapons: Intrinsic exotics (Malfeasance, Devil's Ruin, Leviathan's Breath, Bastion).
- Tactic: Aim down sights until weapon flashes 'Unstoppable Shot' or trigger verb to stagger and drop their 70% damage reduction.
